name: Cross-stitch Studio
original_description: Convert a photo into an editable full-cross-stitch grid, choose a generic RGB palette, track progress and export a printable chart. Supports grids up to 96 x 96 stitches and 24 colours. Sign in to save projects privately in your Workshop account. Photo conversion happens on your device; saved charts contain the derived stitch grid. When embedded downloads are unavailable, save and reopen the chart in Workshop to export in your browser. No licensed thread catalogue, fractional stitches, floss length estimates or generated garment patterns.
summary_ja: 写真を編集可能なクロスステッチ図案に変換し、進捗を記録する。
limitations_ja: 最大96×96目・24色。市販糸のカタログ、部分ステッチ、糸長の推定、服の型紙生成は非対応。
